FAQ:
What are the most prominent services provided by Dr. Shaimaa Al Mahdi at ROYAL VETERINARY CLINIC?
Dr. Shaimaa El Mahdi offers a wide range of comprehensive veterinary services, including diagnosis and treatment for all types of pets. Her services include advanced surgery and preventative care for pets, as well as specialized veterinary consultations on animal nutrition and general care. Dr. Shaimaa aims to provide the best care to ensure the health and well-being of pets.
What preventive services does Dr. Shaimaa Al Mahdi provide for animals?
Dr. Shaimaa El Mahdi provides a variety of preventative services to protect pets from diseases, such as regular medical checkups, preventive vaccinations, and advice on proper nutrition and environmental care. She also provides preventative treatment plans that improve the long-term health of pets.

About me
Royal Veterinary Clinic
, supervised by Dr. Shaimaa El-Mahdy, provides expert veterinary care, vaccinations, surgeries, and grooming in Laurent, Alexandria. Royal Veterinary Clinic, supervised by Dr. Shaimaa El-Mahdy, is a specialized veterinary clinic dedicated to providing the latest healthcare and medical services for pets in Laurent (50 Omar Ibn Al-Khattab Street), Alexandria. The clinic strives to offer a safe and comfortable environment for animals while delivering accurate diagnosis and comprehensive treatments to ensure the health and safety of your pet.
Clinic Services:
Comprehensive medical check-ups and accurate diagnosis of pet diseases (cats and dogs).
Routine and preventive vaccination and immunization schedules to protect against viral and intestinal diseases.
Performing general veterinary surgeries, spaying, and neutering procedures under the highest sterilization and safety standards.
Personal hygiene and grooming care (nail trimming, ear cleaning, and coat care).
Nutritional consultations and behavioral guidance for pet care and protection.
Clinic Address and Contact:
Laurent:
50 Omar Ibn Al-Khattab Street – Alexandria.
